candidates.source_name: World Bank Projects & Operations — Procurement Notices search
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical publisher of General Procurement Notices, Specific Procurement Notices, REOIs and Contract Award Notices for all IDA/IBRD-financed operations in Kosovo, including the Financial Sector Development Project (P507881) that funds instant payments, deposit insurance and credit guarantee work. Notices never appear on Kosovo's national e-Prokurimi portal.
candidates.access_status: public, free, filterable by country; JS-heavy search UI
candidates.legal_status: public disclosure under WB Access to Information Policy
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the country-filtered notice listing on a weekly cadence; capture notice id, project id, borrower, category, deadline; deduplicate on notice id. Prefer the underlying JSON/API endpoint behind the search UI over HTML scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from WB project page
queries_used: World Bank procurement notice Kosovo financial sector payment system

candidates.source_name: World Bank project page — Kosovo Financial Sector Development Project (P507881)
candidates.why_relevant: The single most relevant donor operation in this cell: USD 52m IDA credit approved 16 Jan 2025, implemented by the Central Bank of Kosovo, Deposit Insurance Fund (DIFK) and Kosovo Credit Guarantee Fund, explicitly to catalyse faster/instant payments and digital payment systems. Its procurement plan and ISRs pre-announce the pipeline of goods, IT-supply and consultancy contracts.
candidates.source_subtype: IFI project dossier (procurement plan + implementation status reports)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the project's Documents tab for new Procurement Plan revisions and ISR sequences; each plan revision is a forward-looking tender pipeline.
queries_used: World Bank procurement notice Kosovo financial sector payment system
"Kosovo Financial Sector Development Project" P507881 procurement plan STEP Central Bank consultancy

candidates.source_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo — Tenderët (tenders page)
candidates.why_relevant: BQK is the implementing agency for the World Bank FSDP and publishes both national-rules notices (Njoftim për kontratë / Njoftim për dhënie të kontratës) and World Bank-rules notices on its own site. Confirmed hosting of a World Bank Contract Award Notice for TIPS Clone Connectivity Services — i.e. Kosovo's connection to a TARGET Instant Payment Settlement clone. This is the highest-signal single page in the cell.
candidates.source_subtype: implementing-agency tender board (donor + national notices mixed)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the tenders listing and the /wp-content/uploads/ PDF drops weekly; PDFs carry structured headers (Contract Award Notice, Borrower/Implementing Agency, project id).
candidates.discovered_via_method: Albanian-language search + snowball from WB project
queries_used: "Banka Qendrore e Republikës së Kosovës" njoftim për kontratë prokurim sistemi i pagesave
"Kosovo Financial Sector Development Project" P507881 procurement plan STEP Central Bank consultancy

candidates.source_name: World Bank Group Finances One — Kosovo (contract awards dataset)
candidates.why_relevant: Structured, downloadable contract-award data (supplier name, country, amount, procurement category, project) for WB-financed contracts in Kosovo — the cleanest machine-readable view of who actually wins financial-sector and IT contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pull the 'Major Contract Awards' dataset via the WB Finances API filtered on Kosovo; join to project ids from P507881/P165147.
queries_used: World Bank procurement notice Kosovo financial sector payment system

candidates.source_name: EBRD Client e-Procurement Portal (ECEPP)
candidates.why_relevant: Since the migration, EBRD states that procurement, prequalification, shortlisting and contract award notices for EBRD loan/grant financed contracts are published ONLY on ECEPP. Any Kosovo public-sector EBRD project touching payments, financial infrastructure or FI digitalisation surfaces here first.
candidates.access_status: public notice search; full documents require free supplier registration
candidates.legal_status: public notices; registration ToS applies to document download
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the public notice search filtered on country=Kosovo and sector=Financial Institutions; capture notice id, deadline, procurement type. Registration only if bid documents are needed — respect portal ToS.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from ebrd.com procurement pages
queries_used: EBRD Kosovo procurement notice tender financial institutions digital payments
ECEPP EBRD Client eProcurement Portal ecepp.ebrd.com register notices

candidates.source_name: EBRD Procurement Notices (ebrd.com landing + corporate/consultancy notices)
candidates.why_relevant: Entry point that routes to ECEPP for project procurement and separately lists EBRD's own corporate and TC consultancy assignments; also carries country filters that reveal Kosovo activity. Useful as the stable pointer even as URLs migrate.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl to detect portal/URL migrations; not a primary data source.
queries_used: EBRD Kosovo procurement notice tender financial institutions digital payments

candidates.source_name: EBRD Kosovo news / project summary releases (financial-sector deals)
candidates.why_relevant: EBRD financial-intermediary deals in Kosovo (e.g. Go Digital in the Western Balkans credit line to Banka për Biznes, EU-blended incentives) are private-sector operations that generate no public tender, but the news/project-summary stream reveals where automation and digitalisation money is flowing and which banks are counterparties.
candidates.source_subtype: IFI press release / project summary document
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/news-listing crawl filtered on Kosovo + financial institutions; cross-link to Project Summary Documents for signing dates and amounts.
queries_used: EBRD Kosovo procurement notice tender financial institutions digital payments

candidates.source_name: UNDP Procurement Notices portal
candidates.why_relevant: UNDP Kosovo runs recurring consultancy and IT-supply procurements; confirmed relevant assignment types include banking-sector money-laundering risk assessment expertise. Notices are structured (negotiation id, country, deadline) and never enter the national portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the country-filtered listing; each notice has a stable nego_id URL pattern (view_negotiation.cfm?nego_id=NNNNN) suitable for deduplication.
queries_used: UNDP Kosovo procurement notice UNGM banking financial services consultancy

candidates.source_name: United Nations Global Marketplace (UNGM) — public notices
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates tender and award notices across 40+ UN organisations (UNDP, UNOPS, UNICEF, UNMIK, IOM) with Kosovo-tagged entries; the widest single net for UN-system procurement in the cell, including IT/consultancy contracts adjacent to financial services.
candidates.access_status: public notice pages; some filtering requires a free account
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /Public/Notice/{id} pages discovered through the country-filtered search; polite rate limiting — the site is session/state heavy.
queries_used: UNDP Kosovo procurement notice UNGM banking financial services consultancy

candidates.source_name: Millennium Foundation Kosovo (MFK) — Procurement
candidates.why_relevant: MFK administers the USD 202m MCC Compact (total budget up to USD 236.7m) under MCC Program Procurement Guidelines, publishing GPNs, Specific Procurement Notices (Njoftim Specifik për Prokurim) and a Bid Challenge System. Compact is energy-focused, but it procures large IT, financial-management, audit, banking and payment-agent services, and MFK is the template for how donor-rule procurement bypasses e-Prokurimi.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the procurement page and the linked notice PDFs; parse bilingual (sq/en) notice headers.
queries_used: Millennium Foundation Kosovo MCC compact procurement njoftim prokurimi

candidates.source_name: Crown Agents procurement notices (MFK/MCA-Kosovo procurement agent)
candidates.why_relevant: Donor programmes routinely outsource procurement execution to agents; Crown Agents publishes the MCA-Kosovo / MCC Kosovo GPNs and amendments on its own site. Procurement-agent sites are an under-watched parallel publication channel and often carry notices earlier or in fuller form than the principal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the /procurement-notice/ index for Kosovo-tagged items; treat as a mirror to corroborate MFK notices.
queries_used: devbusiness.un.org UN Development Business dgMarket Kosovo general procurement notice financial sector

candidates.source_name: GIZ Kosovo — Tenders
candidates.why_relevant: GIZ Office Kosovo tenders local and international expertise, including advisory work adjacent to financial-sector reform, SME finance and digitalisation. German cooperation procurement is entirely outside the national portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly page diff; notices are short-lived, so snapshot on each crawl.
queries_used: KfW GIZ Kosovo tender financial sector banking procurement notice

candidates.source_name: Regional Challenge Fund (KfW-financed) — Procurement in Kosovo
candidates.why_relevant: A concrete instance of KfW Financial Cooperation procurement rules applied to Kosovo: the Fund Management Unit publishes calls for tender, award notifications and procurement documentation under KfW Guidelines. Demonstrates the fund-management-unit pattern that also applies to KfW financial-sector and SME credit-line facilities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the Kosovo procurement page and its document links; also use it to enumerate other KfW FMUs in the Western Balkans.
queries_used: KfW GIZ Kosovo tender financial sector banking procurement notice

candidates.source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal + TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) — IPA III Kosovo

Contract notices for works, goods and services under EU external action are published on the Funding & Tenders portal and TED, which offer structured data and an open API — the main machine-readable channel for EU-funded financial-sector and public-finance-management contracts in Kosovo.
candidates.source_subtype: supranational tender gazette with open API
candidates.access_status: public, open API and bulk XML
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED search API filtered on place-of-performance Kosovo (XK) plus CPV codes for financial/IT services; complement with the Commission's Funding & Tenders portal for PRAG calls not mirrored on TED.
candidates.discovered_via_method: Serbian- and Albanian-language searches snowballed to EU portals

candidates.why_relevant: An EU mission procuring independently in Kosovo outside both the national portal and TED for lower-value contracts; relevant mainly for IT/security services and as an example of mission-level procurement channels that also exist for other international presences (UNMIK, OSCE, KFOR).

negative_findings.description: UN Development Business (devbusiness.un.org), historically the mandated publication channel for World Bank and MCC General Procurement Notices, is reported to have phased down operations and ceased website activity on 31 March 2025.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results state UNDB ceased activity; legacy notice URLs such as https://devbusiness.un.org/notices/cdb-p836201 may persist as archive only. Not independently fetch-verified in this pass — treat as unverified hypothesis, not a confirmed death.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection design that anchors on UNDB for donor GPNs will silently return nothing post-2025; the pipeline must be rebuilt on projects.worldbank.org, ECEPP, dgMarket and implementing-entity sites, and historical UNDB pages should be pulled from web archives while they last.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated procurement or tender page was found for the Deposit Insurance Fund of Kosovo (Fondi i Sigurimit të Depozitave në Kosovë) or the Kosovo Credit Guarantee Fund (Fondi Kosovar për Garanci Kreditore), despite both being named implementing agencies of the World Bank Financial Sector Development Project.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian-language search on 'prokurim', 'tender', 'ftesë për ofertë' plus both institution names returned institutional/Facebook/LinkedIn pages and enabling legislation, but no procurement board on fondikgk.org or an FSDK site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the three FSDP implementing agencies may publish their notices only inside World Bank channels or on social media, meaning a site-level watcher would miss them. Collection should lean on the WB notice portal and on the institutions' Facebook/LinkedIn feeds as a fallback.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language searching for donor-funded financial-sector tenders in Kosovo returned almost no Kosovo-specific procurement surface.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'Kosovo tender javni poziv nabavka finansijski sektor projekat finansiran od EU' returned mostly Serbia-focused portals (euzatebe.rs, evropa.gov.rs, tenderteam.rs) plus one generic aggregator page for Kosovo and EEAS Serbian-language press releases.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Donor procurement notices for Kosovo appear to be published in Albanian and English, with Serbian used mainly for political/communications output rather than tender documents. Serbian-language monitoring should target EEAS _sr press releases and Serbian-language Kosovo media rather than tender boards, and Serbian coverage should not be treated as a parity requirement for this cell.

negative_findings.description: Commercial tender aggregators (tendersinfo.com, tendersontime.com, globaltenders.com, biddetail.com, javne-nabavke.com, developmentaid.org) dominate search results for almost every donor+Kosovo query.
negative_findings.result_summary: These sites rank highly, present recycled or SEO-generated 'Kosovo Tenders 2026' pages, and gate actual notice content behind subscriptions; several appear to restate notices without a verifiable primary link.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: They are a credibility and cost trap: high recall, low verifiability, restrictive ToS. They should be excluded from automated collection and used at most for lead generation with mandatory resolution back to the issuing donor's own notice.

negative_findings.description: EBRD, EIB and IFC financial-intermediary operations in Kosovo (credit lines to commercial banks, guarantees, equity, advisory) generate no public procurement notice at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Kosovo EBRD financial-sector activity found in this pass (e.g. up to EUR 5m to a Kosovo bank under Go Digital in the Western Balkans with EU-funded incentives) surfaced only as a press release, not as any tender.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A procurement-notice-only collection strategy will systematically under-count private-sector donor money flowing into Kosovo bank digitalisation. Project Summary Documents, press releases and disclosure registers must be collected alongside tender feeds to see this spend.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact machine-readable endpoints for the World Bank procurement notice search and for ECEPP's country/sector-filtered notice search were not established in this pass; only the human-facing URLs were identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a technical reconnaissance pass on projects.worldbank.org/procurement and ecepp.ebrd.com to capture the underlying JSON/XHR endpoints, pagination and rate limits before building collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: Several plausible donor actors in this cell were not searched or not resolved: Council of Europe Development Bank (CEB), Swiss SECO/SDC, Austrian ADA, Italian AICS, Luxembourg cooperation, IFAD, and the World Bank Group's Western Balkans regional digital/payments programmes; also the EU's Western Balkans Investment Framework (WBIF) and Growth Plan / Reform and Growth Facility procurement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend discovery to WBIF (wbif.eu), CEB, SECO and the EU Growth Plan for the Western Balkans, all of which fund financial-infrastructure and public-finance work and publish their own calls.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian coverage is solid (njoftim për kontratë, njoftim për dhënie të kontratës, njoftim specifik për prokurim, ftesë për ofertë, prokurim, tenderët) but Serbian-language terminology for donor procurement in Kosovo remains largely untested against real notice text.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test Serbian terms (javni poziv za dostavljanje ponuda, obaveštenje o nabavci, poziv za iskazivanje interesa, obaveštenje o dodeli ugovora) against Kosovo-Serb municipal and UN/OSCE channels to confirm whether any donor notice surface exists in Serbian.

coverage_gaps.description: Donor notices are short-lived: MFK, GIZ and BQK drop PDFs that are later rotated off, and UNDB's shutdown removes a historical archive.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot every discovered notice PDF/HTML at collection time into a local content-addressed store, and backfill historical UNDB and dgMarket Kosovo notices from web archives before they degrade further.

coverage_gaps.description: No mapping yet exists between donor project ids (P507881, MCC compact, EBRD operation numbers) and the implementing entities and winning suppliers that appear in Kosovo notices, so awards cannot yet be rolled up by programme or by vendor.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a small actor map keyed on BQK, DIFK/FSDK, KCGF/Fondi Kosovar për Garanci Kreditore, MFK/MCA-Kosovo, and known procurement agents (Crown Agents), with alias and transliteration variants, and use it as the join key across all donor feeds.

brief: Kosovo's donor- and IFI-funded financial-sector procurement is real, active and almost entirely outside the national e-Prokurimi portal, with the World Bank Financial Sector Development Project (P507881, USD 52m IDA, approved January 2025, implemented by the Central Bank of Kosovo with the Deposit Insurance Fund and the Kosovo Credit Guarantee Fund) as the anchor operation — its notices include a contract award for TIPS Clone Connectivity Services, i.e. instant-payments infrastructure. The highest-value monitoring set is small and mostly structured: the World Bank procurement notice portal plus Finances One award data, EBRD's ECEPP (now the sole EBRD publication channel), TED / the EU Funding & Tenders Portal for IPA III under PRAG, UNGM and UNDP Procurement Notices, SAM.gov for USAID and MCC, and the implementing entities' own boards at bqk-kos.org and millenniumkosovo.org, where Albanian-language notices (njoftim për kontratë, njoftim specifik për prokurim) appear alongside English. Two structural blind spots dominate: UN Development Business, long the mandated GPN channel, is reported to have ceased operation in March 2025, and EBRD/EIB/IFC financial-intermediary lending into Kosovo bank digitalisation produces press releases and project summaries but no tender at all, so a notice-only strategy under-counts the money. Serbian-language tender surface for this cell appears near-absent, while Albanian-language local job and announcement boards (KosovaJob, PunaIme, TopKonkurse, kosovo.energy) are a useful mirror for short-lived donor notices provided every item is resolved back to the issuing donor.
